errors.wrong_en: Revenue rose of 18% in the fourth quarter.
errors.right_en: Revenue rose by 18% in the fourth quarter.
errors.why_zh: 变化量用 by；of 只在 a rise of 18% 这种名词结构里用。

errors.wrong_en: Orders increased to 20% after the campaign.
errors.right_en: Orders increased by 20% after the campaign.
errors.why_zh: to 接终点数值；如果 20% 是涨幅，要用 by。

errors.wrong_en: Sales are twice higher than last year.
errors.right_en: Sales are twice as high as last year.
errors.why_zh: 倍数用 as … as，不用 higher than。

errors.wrong_en: The amount of users rose to 3 million.
errors.right_en: The number of users rose to 3 million.
errors.why_zh: users 可数，用 number of；amount of 接不可数名词。

errors.wrong_en: Less customers opened the app this month.
errors.right_en: Fewer customers opened the app this month.
errors.why_zh: customers 可数，用 fewer；less 接不可数名词。

errors.wrong_en: East China had the most highest revenue.
errors.right_en: East China had the highest revenue.
errors.why_zh: highest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

errors.wrong_en: Revenue reached to RMB 92 million in the fourth quarter.
errors.right_en: Revenue reached RMB 92 million in the fourth quarter.
errors.why_zh: reach 后面直接接数值，不加 to。

errors.right_en: Mobile accounts for 52% of the market.
errors.why_zh: occupy 指占据空间；份额用 account for、make up 或 represent。

errors.right_en: Its share rose 6 percentage points to 52%.
errors.why_zh: 两个百分比相减，结果是百分点，不是百分比。
remain 后面接形容词 stable，不接副词 stably。

errors.wrong_en: Order volume fluctuated up and down all year.
errors.why_zh: fluctuate 本身已经包含上下变化，up and down 重复。

errors.wrong_en: Compared with last year, sales increased this year.
errors.right_en: Sales increased this year, compared with last year.
errors.why_zh: Compared with 的逻辑主语要和主句主语一致，否则读者不知道谁和谁比。

errors.wrong_en: First, the order is place in the app.
errors.right_en: First, the order is placed in the app.
errors.why_zh: 被动语态用过去分词 placed，不是原形 place。

errors.wrong_en: The factory replaced by apartment towers last year.
errors.right_en: The factory was replaced by apartment towers last year.
errors.why_zh: 地图变化用过去时被动，别漏掉 was。

errors.wrong_en: Revenue rose, while margin rose as well.
errors.right_en: Revenue and margin rose in tandem.
errors.why_zh: while 用来对比相反或不同的趋势；同向变化用 in tandem 或 and。
